does_not_measure: persona style, stance, and writing quality
reason: no graph arm beat F-SOURCE on factual reliability or copy and leakage
rule: Compare only questions where F-SOURCE, F-REL, F-DESC, and F-HOP are all complete. Primary key: faithfulness pass rate from the existing deterministic factual check. Secondary key: source-copy or prompt-leak failure rate. A graph arm is chosen only when it strictly beats F-SOURCE on the primary key, or ties that key and strictly beats F-SOURCE on the secondary key. Usable graph context is reported and is not a score. Retry rate and generation latency break ties only between graph arms that already beat F-SOURCE. A tie, an incomplete pilot, or no such benefit freezes F-SOURCE.
